limits: This independent integral verifies actual input bookkeeping, not source geometry interpretation or physical stiffness calibration.
RNA is a rigid mass carrier with source-dependent distributed inertia, not proof of DTU10MW target mass/CG/inertia.
Positive sampled detJ does not establish all element quality metrics or response mesh convergence.
No load-response/initial-state/capacity/physical damping inference from this text audit.

RNA_discrete_inertia_review.identity: RUN032 actual input B31 rigid RNA carrier; no physical DTU10MW inertia validation
RNA_discrete_inertia_review.preferred_for_RUN036_equivalence: B31_discrete_J_CG_tensor_kgm2: full-precision endpoint-lumped + exact cross-section calculation validated against printed real DAT; use same mass and CG.
RNA_discrete_inertia_review.preferred_for_RUN037_representation_sens: continuous_cylinder_J_CG_tensor_kgm2: same exported input densities, mass and CG; mathematical continuous mass distribution, not official physical RNA inertia.
RNA_discrete_inertia_review.default_mass_formulation: Official BEAM SECTION: LUMPED=YES, ROTARY INERTIA=EXACT. No isotropic option is present in input.
RNA_discrete_inertia_review.discrete_prediction: Sum endpoints m_e/2 at each coordinate, plus exact circular cross-section rotary inertia; J_CG matches real DAT to printed last-digit rounding.
RNA_discrete_inertia_review.why_difference: Each straight uniform beam adds mL^2/6 (I−tt^T) to continuous inertia when endpoint-lumped; no mass or CG change.
RNA_discrete_inertia_review.CG_vs_RP_confirmation: DAT xy/xz≈0 and yz=−664405.4 match J_CG. J_RP has yz≈−539322.873 from parallel-axis shift; do not shift J_CG twice.
RNA_discrete_inertia_review.M6_block_formula: [mI, −m[d]x; +m[d]x, J_CG+m((d.d)I−dd^T)], v_CG=v_RP+omega×d. Mixed blocks have kg/kg*m/kg*m^2 units.
RNA_discrete_inertia_review.not_claimed: No new solver/API invocation; DAT snapshot is real root-run output. Mathematical discrete prediction is verified to DAT print precision, not extracted full-precision assembled mass matrix.

scientific_scope: Actual reconstructed input mass/CG/discrete inertia implementation verified; source mass/geometry/inertia physical design calibration remains separate. Continuum vs discrete J is a representation sensitivity, not physical validation.
